title: Formatting examples
text: This page shows some formatting options available in pages content. You can take a look at the formatting.qmd file to see which markdown syntax is used.

title: Formatting examples
text:
Basic formatting
Text can be put in bold, italic or verbatim.
It is possible to create lists:

item 1
item 2
item 3

Which can be ordered:

item 1
item 2
item 3

URLs can be inserted as is:
https://example.com
Or as a link.
You can also link to another site page like publications.
Footnotes are available too1.

title: Formatting examples
text:
Verbatim and source code
Text can be shown verbatim in a monospace font.
My name is Darouine
I like evolving
Everythin I'm doing
Is very interesting
For source code, syntax highlighting is available.
def hello() -> None:
    print("Hello")
hello <- function() { print("Hello") }
